pattern: SELECT .+ FROM .+ WHERE Highschooler\.ID = ([a-zA-Z0-9]+)\) AND ID NOT EXISTS \(\(SELECT liked\_id FROM Likes WHERE Highschooler\.ID = liked\_id\)
correction: Replace the query with: SELECT name FROM Highschooler EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.id

metadata.description: This rule corrects SQL queries that use incorrect subqueries and operators to find students not in both the Friend and Likes tables.
